title: Generic Effective-Forcing Boundary & Parallel DIVDRA Composition Readiness
problem_statement: Canonical parallel workers share forcing_registry as read-only input, while serialized DIVDRA composes a temporary drainage row into mutable forcing. Whole-registry copying or a separate DIVDRA worker-pool is rejected as the intended scalable production direction.
selected_direction: Introduce in a separate structural candidate a generic resolved-column explicit-effective-forcing execution seam below registry lookup and above the existing transaction/backend path; ordinary callers pass canonical forcing unchanged and optional processes may provide worker-local sparse overrides.
next_required_step: separate structural workunit for the generic resolved-column explicit-effective-forcing executor seam; independent qualification required before dependent parallel DIVDRA composition
